dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you not have a tier that's even higher than that?

dialogues.speaker: Leifhelm
dialogues.text: Ahem, in that case, we would be talking about the ones with weird powers, like gods, demons and ancient dragons...!

dialogues.speaker: Leifhelm
dialogues.text: I'm not really creating a power ranking. The whole point of this exercise is to help me establish my standards and set a goal for myself. So why would I include all that?

dialogues.speaker: Leifhelm
dialogues.text: Besides, there are so many factors that go into a loss or a victory. Things like the strengths and weaknesses of each side, and the proper application of battle tactics, these are all important... Only people who don't understand battle come up with those silly rankings and lists all the time!
